requirements.RC-0079: Eclipse overlay ve tutulma etkileri ilerleyen profesyonel modüllerde kullanılabilecek.

invariants: The calculation layer accepts only explicit provenance-tagged eclipse events; it never invents eclipse dates, locations or interpretive claims.
Eclipse longitudes must be normalized and source/dataVersion provenance must match the natal placement set.
The overlay exposes deterministic conjunction/opposition contacts to natal bodies under an explicit caller-controlled orb.
Events outside the configured orb create no contact and invalid input fails closed.
The core contains no device-time or network fallback and is suitable as neutral data infrastructure for later professional eclipse modules.
